thread:
mira: hey folks — can someone take a quick look at #PR 4829? small batching change that tweaks the KV prefetch ordering to avoid a rare deadlock. I ran unit + local perf tests but want an extra set of eyes before merging in the evening window. link: https://git.company/repo/pulls/4829

alex: putting it on my queue, I can do a pass in ~45m. any flaky repro steps I should try locally?

mira: thanks — no reliable repro, it popped under high QPS on staging. You can run the stress job: `./dev/stress.sh --profile=batcher-kv-highqps` (10m) — it reproduces failure ~1/200 runs.

sam: i can do a quick static/read-through now. quick note: in batcher.cc line 412 the `if (!ready())` looks like it could swallow an early error — can you add a log or change to `if (ready() == OK)`?

mira: good catch, i'll push that as a tiny follow-up. the core change is a reorder: prefetch -> attach -> commit instead of attach -> prefetch. should be backwards compatible.

oliver: heads-up: this touches the hot path for small-seq workloads. can we run a latency smoke after merge? if 95th jumps we need a rollback plan ready.

mira: yes — rollback plan is `rdctl deployments rollback --component=batcher --from-pr=4829` and i've updated the PR description with the rollback steps.

qa-bot: started test run for PR 4829 — CI: queued -> running (staging smoke + integration). https://ci.company/jobs/4829

alex: looked through — code reads fine, one nit about a comment. test coverage looks adequate. i'm +1 pending CI green. :thumbsup:

sam: quick inline suggestion pushed as comment (prefer explicit enum check). nothing blocking.

mira: pushed a small fix for the enum check and added the extra log alex asked for. will squash after CI passes.

deploy-bot: scheduled merge window tonight 02:00 UTC — auto-merge will run if CI & canary pass. current CI: running (integration 7/9, smoke passed).

oliver: tag me when you flip the canary so I can watch metrics (I'll be on call).

mira: will do. thanks all — plan is to merge after integration finishes and canary looks good. i'll post here once merged or if we need to back out.

alex: thanks — thx for the clear rollback command.

mira: np, appreciate the quick help. :pray:

qa-bot: CI complete: integration 9/9 -> all green. canary deployment in progress.

deploy-bot: canary deployed to 5% traffic, health checks OK. monitoring: https://metrics.company/dashboards/batcher-canary-4829

oliver: watching latency now — so far stable for 10m.

mira: merging now (squash+merge). will update if anything weird shows up.

deploy-bot: PR 4829 merged by mira at 1749123581, release pipeline started.

mira: merged ✅ — thanks everyone. will keep an eye on the dashboard for the next 30m and ping if rollback needed.
